name: load-template-library
body: Load template library: resolve the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (a relative path resolved against the deck root, or an absolute path), otherwise the local `templates/`; neither resolvable = error (templates-dir-required) — then validate the resolved root fail-fast (templates-dir-validation) and build the template and theme registries from its files; the first failure is a templates error. The step-6 reference checks cover a theme's `theme.css` and every stylesheet it imports — the same theme directory, another theme, or `media/` (imports followed, bounded and cycle-safe across the whole import graph, cycles detected): a relative `url()`/`@import` resolves from the importing file's own location, a `url()`/`@import` with the reserved `media:` prefix resolves to an existing file under the resolved library's `media/` (relative to `media/` and staying within it), and a `url()`/`@import` with the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix resolves to an existing file inside that theme's directory (an unknown `<name>` is an error); a missing file, an absolute path, a `..` escape, or any other scheme is reported with the CSS file and line (theme-media-references). A configured path is authoritative: the local `templates/` is consulted only when no path is configured. The value used by a running session is the one captured at startup: a later change to the configured `templates:` value keeps the pinned root and the reload path shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
